title: Who brings what
description: Say what is needed, and guests and the team pick what they bring.

fields.title: What to bring
fields.noteHint: For example: dry red, if possible

remove.title: Delete “{title}”?
remove.body: The need is deleted together with everything guests promised for it.

empty.title: You have not asked for anything yet
empty.body: Add the first need — for example “Bottles of wine, 12”. Guests see it on their link and pick their part.

mine.unitsHint: Write 0 if you can no longer bring any.

errors.taken: Someone else offered in the meantime. Still left to bring: {left}.
errors.belowClaimed: Guests have already promised {claimed}. You cannot ask for less than that.

guest.title: Who brings what
guest.intro: If you would like to help, pick what you bring. You can change or withdraw at any time.
guest.full: Everything is covered here. Thank you!
